correctness.rationale: A nonsingular exact six-parameter interpolant matrix and divided-difference Hermite limit give uniform convergence of the scaled interpolation operator. Its two explicitly factored quadratics have analytically determined global maxima; optimizing the first two data gives the sharp factor two. The balance equation factors and has the unique admissible positive root. The checker confirms the critical identities and 30 independently generated rational examples, but finite tests are not used to justify quantified claims.
